proof_body:
by
  intro a b r p q hr
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x₀, y₀, h₁, h₂⟩
    have hr2 : 0 < r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have : r ^ 2 * r ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 * ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) := by
      calc r ^ 2 * r ^ 2 = ((x₀ - a) * (p - a) + (y₀ - b) * (q - b)) ^ 2 := by rw [h₂]; ring
        _ ≤ ((x₀ - a) ^ 2 + (y₀ - b) ^ 2) * ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) := by
            linarith [sq_nonneg ((x₀ - a) * (q - b) - (y₀ - b) * (p - a))]
        _ = r ^ 2 * ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) := by rw [h₁]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hr2
  · intro h
    have hN : 0 < (p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) h
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s ^ 2 = (p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := ⟨_, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)⟩
    refine ⟨a + (r ^ 2 * (p - a) - r * (q - b) * s) / ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2), b + (r ^ 2 * (q - b) + r * (p - a) * s) / ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (a + (r ^ 2 * (p - a) - r * (q - b) * s) / ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) - a) ^ 2 + (b + (r ^ 2 * (q - b) + r * (p - a) * s) / ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) - b) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) / ((p - a) ^ 2 + (q - b) ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, hs]
      field_simp; ring
    · field_simp; ring
